package.name: hhros2_motion_cores
package.description: The motion-control "dual core" (02_motion_control): the RL policy core and the WBC/QP core. Both are rclcpp components that, at 50-100 Hz, turn task commands plus the state estimate into a hybrid joint reference for the chainable humanoid_base_controller. Arbitration ensures only one core drives the actuators at a time.
